summary: 출하된 스테이지에 배치된 Text는 안내 문구를 표시하는 액터다. 충돌체·위험 판정·입력 제어를 추가하지 않는다. 다만 TextComponent 전체가 시뮬레이션 동작 없는 타입은 아니다. 런타임에서 생성되는 수명과 소유자가 있는 Text는 퇴장 요청 및 TextExit 이벤트를 처리한다.

corrections: The header says RequestExit is called only by six named gameplay component families. A repeated rel32 scan of both .text and il2cpp additionally finds helper calls at 0x180222e80, 0x1802265c0, 0x18022d0e0 and an adjustor jump at 0x180209974. Nearest indexed method names are unreliable for these helper addresses. Their upstream reachability is unresolved; do not claim exhaustive absence of other callers.

No direct rel32 call to stage Creator 0x18171b200 was found; the registered delegate remains the supported stage path. Runtime calls found include BallReceiver 0x1816b4ebc; RallyJudge 0x1816e29a7/0x1816e3c81 and SetText 0x1816e284a; EndlessLandmine 0x18182fead; FakeTimer 0x181843549/0x1818435f0; GiantEnemy 0x181859205/0x181858fea/0x1818592a0; Mole 0x181881536/0x181881359/0x1818815d0. A byte scan alone does not establish indirect-call reachability.

Existing afterStep is not an exact OnPost transcription: it subtracts floating seconds and emits event 62 immediately upon expiry, whereas native OnPost subtracts FP raw and only requests exit; native OnExit emits the event later.
Existing interface test omits the required displays function. Module exports labels but no displays. The task's tests passing does not establish shared interface compliance.

NativeBehaviour none is valid only for the observed immediate, stationary, zero-lifetime stage actors. Nonzero velocity or createThreshold is accepted with warnings, although generic movement/deferred creation has not been verified; shared rules require refusal for such unresolved cases.

Existing decoder preserves decimal FP values verbatim, which is not raw-exact: authored fontSize 0.7 truncates to raw 45875, i.e. 0.6999969482421875. Negative integer slots must first truncate to FP raw before sar 16; Math.floor(decimal) differs close to zero.

verification.unitTests: node --test source-migration/source-text-devices.test.cjs: existing 17 tests pass. No existing test was edited and no new test file was authorized by name.
verification.regression: node --test source-migration/*.test.cjs: 244 tests pass, 0 fail, exit 0 at verification time.
measured: All decoded variants contain 17 Text instances across 13 distinct stages, including ten World stages. Every instance has playerCount 0, createThreshold 0, empty literal text, color 0 and both velocity slots 0.

Selected actual online variants with population-rules.cjs for each of the ten World stages at 2..8 players: 70/70 Text compiles with no warnings. st_w_02_02 and st_w_10_03 select variant 1 at 5..8 players and variant 0 at 2..4. st_w_03_03 has two labels; every other selected stage has one.
For all 70 selected stage/count combinations, state survives JSON stringify/parse and produces identical state after one subsequent tick.
Existing tests check 3000 updates per one of the 17 authored instances without solids, hazards, events or deaths; lifetime remains zero and exit flag remains clear.

Separate lifetime probe: lifeTime 1 at dt 1/60 expires in existing JS at tick 60; native integer arithmetic requires ceil(65536/1092) = 61 ticks. This is a confirmed mismatch, not a failing result of the existing 17 tests.
Direct binary float reads confirm FP scale and outline constant. Metadata recheck confirms 19 declared TextComponent methods and 196/112/84 Creator/collision-hook counts.
verification.limits: No original game code ran. No human gameplay or rendered visual fidelity comparison was performed. Existing tests alone do not cover interface compliance, raw FP accuracy or the native exit lifecycle.

unlocks.connectedAs: Unregistered; no runtime changes made. Brief identifies st_w_03_03 and st_w_02_02 as opening with other briefs; this report does not claim those other modules are ready.

unresolved: Existing module changes are forbidden by the current user instruction. FP timer correction, displays export, lifecycle separation, precise slot decoding and fail-closed unsupported inputs remain to be implemented and tested by the owner.
Runtime floating-text API is outside the verified stage-only scope. Owner notifications must be dispatched at actual actor exit, not merely lifetime expiry.

Prototype internals and zero-initialized component allocator are not independently disassembled here. The stage conclusion relies on the established zero-default contract and the observed stage path; no absolute proof of every possible entity prototype is claimed.
Generic movement for nonzero Text velocity and deferred actor creation are unresolved. Existing compile warns rather than throws, so synthetic unsupported actors are not fail-closed.

RequestExit helper callers and indirect callers were not traced to all upstream roots. Absence of OnRecvEvent means no component-specific event handler, not proof that no generic actor lifecycle can affect a Text.

Localized GameTextManager strings, modifyText substitutions, actual fonts, follow rendering and complete visual behavior are not ported or verified. labels preserves data; it does not demonstrate a faithful rendered label.

Full stage/runtime compilation after registration and coordination with other device modules was not performed, as registration is prohibited. Only Text module compilation is verified for the 70 selected World stage/count combinations.
